infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera is used for on-device pose landmarks during exercise setup. Frames are processed locally; only pose landmarks may be shared if you explicitly enable remote enhancement.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Recognize spoken commands while you use SpineCare. Speech services may require network access.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is used only when you initiate voice commands.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SpineCare to show a live camera preview for exercise setup. This prototype does not upload or save camera video.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow SpineCare to listen for your spoken exercise commands when you tap the microphone.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow SpineCare to recognize English or Romanian spoken exercise commands.
